Title: Analog Coffee
Note: Capitol Hill. Corner windows, good light on a grey day, and people stay for hours.

Title: Victrola Coffee Roasters
Note: The long table is the point. Bring a laptop and settle in.

Title: Cafe Allegro
Note: Down an alley in the U District. The oldest espresso bar in Seattle and it still feels like a study hall.

Title: Elm Coffee Roasters
Note: Pioneer Square. Bright, quiet, high ceilings, and a pastry case worth the detour.

Title: Milstead & Co.
Note: Fremont, by the water. They rotate roasters, so ask what is on today.

Title: Zoka Coffee Roaster & Tea Company
Note: Green Lake. Big tables, lots of outlets, and the loop is a five-minute walk away.

Title: Fuel Coffee
Note: Small neighbourhood rooms in Wallingford and Montlake. The kind of place you become a regular at.

Title: Herkimer Coffee
Note: Phinney Ridge and Green Lake. Unfussy, consistent, and full of people reading.
